fidio-examples.ifa

Fidio: Video Simulation

Text-based video operations using Irosu I/O, string manipulation, and timing.

Use Case 1: Frame-by-Frame Display

// frames.ifa - Simulate frame display

ayanmo frames = [
    "[    ]",
    "[ #  ]",
    "[ ## ]",
    "[ ###]",
    "[####]"
];

ese play_frames(fps, count) {
    ayanmo delay = 1000 / fps;
    ayanmo i = 0;
    nigba (i < count) {
        ayanmo f = i % Ogunda.iwọn(frames);
        Irosu.fo(frames[f]);
        Oyeku.sun(delay);
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }
}

// Usage
Irosu.fo("Playing animation at 5 FPS:");
play_frames(5, 15);
Irosu.fo("Playback complete");

Use Case 2: Video Metadata Display

// metadata.ifa - Display video file info

ese show_metadata(path) {
    ti (!Odi.wa(path)) {
        Irosu.kigbe("File not found: " + path);
        padap?;
    }

    ayanmo size = Odi.ka(path);
    ayanmo name = path;

    Irosu.fo("=== Video Info ===");
    Irosu.fo("File: " + name);
    Irosu.fo("Size: " + Ika.gigun(size) + " bytes");
    Irosu.fo("Format: MP4 (detected)");
    Irosu.fo("Resolution: 1920x1080 (simulated)");
}

ese list_videos(dir) {
    Irosu.fo("Scanning directory: " + dir);
    Irosu.fo("Files found (simulated):");
    Irosu.fo("  1. vacation.mp4");
    Irosu.fo("  2. tutorial.mp4");
    Irosu.fo("  3. presentation.mp4");
}

// Usage
show_metadata("vacation.mp4");
Irosu.fo("");
list_videos("./videos");

Use Case 3: Progress Tracker

// progress.ifa - Track video processing

ese process_video(input, output) {
    ti (!Odi.wa(input)) {
        Irosu.kigbe("Input not found");
        padap? iro;
    }

    ayanmo data = Odi.ka(input);
    ayanmo total = Ika.gigun(data);
    ayanmo chunk = total / 10;
    ayanmo i = 0;

    Irosu.fo("Processing: " + input + " -> " + output);
    nigba (i < 10) {
        ayanmo pct = (i + 1) * 10;
        ayanmo bar = "";
        ayanmo j = 0;
        nigba (j < 10) {
            ti (j <= i) {
                ayanmo bar = bar + "#";
            } bibẹkọ {
                ayanmo bar = bar + "-";
            }
            ayanmo j = j + 1;
        }
        Irosu.fo("[" + bar + "] " + pct + "%");
        Oyeku.sun(200);
        ayanmo i = i + 1;
    }

    Odi.ko(output, data);
    Irosu.fo("Output saved: " + output);
    padap? otito;
}

// Usage
process_video("source.mp4", "output.mp4");
